title: machaeranthera shastensis var. eradiata
intro: Machaeranthera shastensis var. eradiata, commonly known as Shasta false goldenrod, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Shasta false goldenrod include its potential to soothe and calm the body, reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant are attributed to its sesquiterpene lactones, particularly eradiatin and other compounds, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
